free_text: A biopsy is recommended because the clinical picture involves a PI-RADS 4 finding on MRI and a rising PSA trend from 3.1 ng/mL to 7.2 ng/mL. Although the documented prior biopsy grade is unknown, the combination of a high-risk imaging finding and rising PSA trajectory supports proceeding with further histological assessment. The decision was reached because the evidence converged despite the missing histological context.
